title: The open right-adjoint image preserves supported quasi-coherent complexes
statement: Let X be quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with chosen derived module categories on X and its over-sites [def-pc-derived-category]. Let T be closed, U compact open, L derived over-site restriction to U, and let L be left adjoint to any R. If K has quasi-coherent cohomology with all stalks outside T zero, then R(L(K)) has quasi-coherent cohomology with all stalks outside T zero. No cone or distinguished triangle is part of the statement.

proof.text: Transport restriction and its derived right adjoint through Modules.overEquiv; uniqueness of right adjoints identifies R with the transported derived direct image. Restriction preserves quasi-coherent cohomology. The open immersion is quasi-compact by quasi-separatedness of X and compactness of U, and separated, so derived direct image preserves quasi-coherent cohomology.

For O equal to the complement of T, supported restriction makes K on O, and thus on U intersect O, zero. Open base change identifies restriction of R(L(K)) to O with derived direct image of that zero complex. Exact homology/restriction and stalk comparison give zero homology stalks outside T.

theorem supported_open_unit_image_properties
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ W : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (R : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ⥤
      schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (adj : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ R)
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (hKT : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
        K.obj).val.presheaf x))) :
    schemeDerivedQCohProperty X
      (R.obj ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
        (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
        (R.obj ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj))).val.presheaf x)))
